prompt: Copy the 'github' MCP server from Claude Code to Codex.
setup: ~/.codex/config.toml has a [projects] table, an existing [mcp_servers.idea] section with an inline comment on its header line, and no 'github' server.

The review is conducted from Claude Code or Copilot CLI, not from Codex CLI: the target is the Codex MCP file, and the running-host caveat forbids writing an MCP file that belongs to the agent running the skill.
expected: The plan names ~/.codex/config.toml with the operation 'append section' and prints a backup path.
The file gains a [mcp_servers.github] section with url = "https://api.example.com/mcp" at the end, preceded by one blank line.
Every pre-existing line of config.toml, including the [mcp_servers.idea] section and its comment, is byte-identical.
The comparison is re-run and 'github' is reported as present on all three agents.
must_not: Rewrite or reformat any existing TOML section.
Write a quoted key for a bare-safe name or an unquoted key for a dotted name.
Write the Codex MCP file when the skill is running inside Codex CLI; there it prints the codex mcp add command instead, which is why this scenario does not claim the codex platform.
